BReorderAudioTechnicalAudit.provenance: Independent adversarial review supplied on 2026-07-24; re-run locally with the documented FFmpeg/PCM method on 2026-07-25. Technical measurement only, not a subjective listening result.

candidate.analysisEndRule: Use 667/30 seconds, not the decoded AAC tail/padding beyond the visual candidate duration.

ffmpeg.pcmFormat: interleaved IEEE-754 little-endian float32, stereo, 44100 Hz; values are normalized to approximately [-1, 1].

rmsMethod.formula: overallRmsDbfs = 20 * log10(sqrt(sum(channelSample^2) / (2 * N))) for the N sample frames in the half-open window; use FFmpeg astats Overall RMS level dB and round only for the summary.

adjacentSampleJumpMethod.formula: max(abs(x[channel][n + 1] - x[channel][n])) over each stereo channel; do not compare adjacent interleaved left/right values.

BReorderAudioTechnicalAudit.interpretation: The fade/pocket prevents a sample-level click, but the roughly 16.77dB energy drop can be heard as a deliberate restart. The author must review this exact B candidate with headphones before an Editorial GO; a rejection requires an audio-only successor sample rather than retroactive approval.

decodedSourceSimilarity.method: FFmpeg SSIM between decoded final-candidate frames and the same 1920x1080 master frames scaled to 960x540 with Lanczos. Values include H.264 review encoding; C source n=4..354 is intentionally excluded because the DOM-ring stand-in overlays it.

CStandIn.purpose: A local composited persistent DOM-ring stand-in to test the hybrid reading.
CStandIn.visualRule: Warm open ring remains across n=4..354, rotates at the measured clockwise 396.4 degrees/s and fades out while source n=337..354 forms its real orange arc.
CStandIn.nonProductionBoundary: It is intentionally allowed to read as a spinner in order to make that editorial risk comparable; it is not a formal DOM implementation decision.
